# Review-Loop Config — autopilot (self-hosting)

> Stub that follows the roster (`project-config-template/review-loop-config.md`): no seat fields
> and no override block, so every seat (loop reviewer, implementer, verification author, qc panel)
> is the roster's. Seat history before 2026-11-06 is in git; roster changes are logged in the
> template's changelog. Consumed by `scripts/resolve-review-loop.sh` (precedence slot 3).

## Settings

- on_family_conflict: fallback

<!-- exclude_allowlist below: references/official-qualification-defaults.json is generated by
     scripts/build-qualification-defaults.js from the recipe and evidence bundles; reviewers read
     the recipe, and build --check re-derives the artifact. -->
- exclude_allowlist: references/official-qualification-defaults.json
<!-- exclude_allowlist below: evals/skill-onoff/packs/ holds frozen eval arm packs — verbatim copies of skill files and fixtures pinned by each campaign's pre-registration; a campaign diff can add ~70k lines there, too large for a review packet. Reviewers read the arm manifests, prereg and scorer; the depth-0 merger checks the shipped SKILL.md is byte-identical to the evaluated pack. -->
- exclude_allowlist: evals/skill-onoff/packs/**
<!-- review_packet_deny_extra: comma-separated extra packet deny patterns (additive
     floor = DEFAULT_PACKET_DENY_LIST). Empty = []. Grammar: normalizeDenyList. -->
- review_packet_deny_extra:
<!-- in_rail_review: auto|single|panel. auto uses the sealed panel as the in-loop review station when the QC panel is complete. -->
- in_rail_review: auto
<!-- list one more seat than the minimum to get a standby -->
- provider_readiness_receipt_ttl_seconds: 300
- provider_readiness_fallback_family_constraint: different
